entries.title: Finite-field representation
entries.domain: GF(p^n), monic irreducible polynomial P of degree n
entries.finding: Quotient by a polynomial is distinct from integer reduction modulo p or q. Registered polynomials remain the existing GF4, GF8, GF9 and GF16 profiles.
entries.evidence: Independent exact arithmetic checks cover the registered fields. No new GF80 amplitude model is implied.

entries.title: Quadratic character
entries.domain: Odd characteristic; registered executable profile GF9
entries.formula: η(0)=0; η(x)=+1 if x^((q−1)/2)=1, −1 if the result is −1 in F_q
entries.finding: Convert the field sign to the real values ±1. The half exponent formula is unavailable in characteristic 2, where squaring is bijective.
entries.evidence: Independent GF9 power and square classification.

entries.title: Two-dimensional symplectic determinant
entries.domain: 2×2 matrices over any registered finite field
entries.formula: Mᵀ Ω M=(ad−bc) Ω; M is symplectic iff ad−bc=1 in F_q
entries.finding: Sp(2,F_q)=SL(2,F_q) for this two-dimensional convention, including characteristic 2. Reduce field products by the defining polynomial. A label map alone supplies no metaplectic amplitude operator.
entries.evidence: Direct determinant / alternating-form identity tests; nonunit determinants are reported as invalid symplectic maps.

entries.finding: q0 and p0 label the reflection center. R is Hermitian, involutive and unit trace in this convention.
entries.evidence: All GF9 reflections checked for Hermiticity, square=I, trace=1 and trace orthogonality.

entries.title: Pure-state Wigner function
entries.domain: Normalized pure complex state; odd characteristic (GF9 profile)
entries.finding: Rows are q0 and columns p0. Momentum marginal is the probability of the negative-sign Fourier state. Negative Wigner values are allowed. This command does not accept mixed density matrices.
entries.evidence: Independent basis, Fourier-line, negative-state, purity, marginals and covariance checks.

entries.title: Wigner mana convention
entries.domain: The implemented normalized odd-characteristic Wigner representation
entries.finding: Declare logarithm base 2; other conventions use natural logarithms. A stabilizer pure state has zero mana to numerical tolerance; positivity alone is not a general mixed-state stabilizer criterion.
entries.evidence: Two-basis superposition gives Σ|W|=5/3 and M₂=log₂(5/3). Roundoff is retained in raw returns.

entries.title: Racah spin coupling
entries.domain: Ordinary SU(2); real Clebsch–Gordan coefficients in a complex-amplitude model
entries.finding: The displayed sum and k bounds agree with the Condon–Shortley convention after imposing triangle, half-integer and magnetic selection rules. This is not factorial arithmetic modulo a prime. Implementation bounds j1,j2,J to 0..6.
entries.evidence: Independent exact-rational finite-sum oracle and singlet/triplet, highest-weight, orthogonality checks. Full displayed LaTeX is retained in parsed evidence.

entries.title: Arithmetic delta and Fermat quotient
entries.domain: Integer lifts modulo p² to residues modulo p; prime p
entries.finding: Divide the integer numerator before reduction. δ is defined for nonunits too, but the Fermat quotient above is for units. δ≡−x q_p(x) mod p on units. This is an arithmetic map, not a linear ordinary derivative.
entries.evidence: Exact BigInt evaluation; lift independence and unit/nonunit tests. Terminal supports prime p=2..97 and integer strings.

entries.title: Arithmetic product rule
entries.domain: Arithmetic delta reduced modulo a prime
entries.finding: The displayed reduced product rule is correct. The exact integer form is xδy+yδx−pδxδy. Delta is not additive: at p=3, δ(1+1)=1 while δ(1)+δ(1)=0.
entries.evidence: Independent residue / product tests include p=2 and nonunits. The command also displays the nonadditivity defect.

entries.title: Forward complex Cayley step
entries.domain: Finite complex Hermitian H, real dt, hbar>0
entries.formula: (I+i dt H/(2ℏ)) ψ_next=(I−i dt H/(2ℏ)) ψ_now
entries.finding: Restores the forward Schrödinger sign. Exact arithmetic preserves norm, but numerical solves have residuals. This rational map approximates the exponential; at scalar H=1, dt=2, hbar=1 it gives −i instead of exp(−2i). Inspect-only calculation, separate from the active field state.
entries.evidence: Complex pivoted solve, residual and norm checks, reversibility and small-step phase accuracy. H dimension 1..8; |dt|≤100. A finite-field denominator can be singular.

entries.title: Proposed Klein transmission
entries.domain: Proposed lattice momenta and electrostatic step; current branches unspecified
entries.finding: In the stated Klein zone, a nonnegative principal k2 gives r2<0. The formula can yield a negative probability. A Hamiltonian and discrete current must be specified before implementing transmission.
entries.evidence: hbar=c=m=a=1, E=2,V0=4 gives k1=k2=2π/3 and T=−3. Real dispersion requires 0≤ε²−m²c⁴≤4ℏ²c²/a²; fixed-a V0→∞ is outside the band. See docs/relativity-audit.txt.

entries.title: Modular relativistic partial-wave phase
entries.domain: No specified finite-field Bessel functions, matching law or phase definition
entries.formula: tan δ_l=(k j_l′(kR)−γ j_l(kR))/(k n_l′(kR)−γ n_l(kR)) mod p
entries.finding: A conditional real/complex scalar continuum matching identity exists, using γ=f′/f and a specified exterior convention. It does not define modular Bessel functions or a lattice Dirac phase shift.
entries.evidence: Ordinary Bessel series contain factorial denominators that vanish modulo p. Full definitions, coupled spinor matching and a nonsingular boundary rule are missing. See docs/relativity-audit.txt.

entries.title: Automaton commutator
entries.domain: Operator normalizations and Hosc offset unspecified
entries.finding: The equality mixes j and j+1/2 normalizations. A controlled low-energy limit may be studied only after defining X,P,H and the state sequence. It is not the exact canonical commutator on a whole finite complex space.
entries.evidence: With Hosc=ℏω((j+1/2)I−Jz), j=1,Jz=1 gives coefficients 1 and 2/3. Also Tr([X,P])=0 but Tr(iℏI)=iℏd. Primary ’t Hooft conventions differ; see relativity audit.

entries.domain: Reported equations 70,84,210 are not supplied in full

entries.title: GF4 Pauli-label mapping
entries.domain: Qubit Pauli operators modulo scalar phases; additive GF4^n labels
entries.formula: Commutation iff Σ_i Tr_(4/2)(u_i v_i²)=0 in GF2
entries.finding: State a fixed X/Z-to-GF4 basis map. The correspondence quotients out Pauli phases and uses the sum over all coordinates; it is not equality of the full Pauli group with the multiplicative field.
entries.evidence: CRSS trace-Hermitian construction supports the qualified label mapping. No error-correction decoder or threshold is implemented.

entries.title: Computational complexity claims
entries.domain: Algorithm and representation dependent operation counts
entries.formula: Schoolbook multiplication O(n²); Karatsuba O(n^(log₂3)); sparse direct Wigner O(q³)
entries.finding: Karatsuba is not O(n log n). Fast convolution/Fourier bounds require a suitable algorithm and representation. Trace needs Frobenius evaluations as well as additions. Log/Zech tables use O(q) storage and do not justify GF80-sized tables.
entries.evidence: No benchmarks were supplied or performed. The release uses small direct polynomial and sparse reflection calculations; it makes no fast-transform claim.

entries.title: 500-equation and physical claims
entries.domain: Supplied audit narrative, not the full source suite
entries.finding: Only expressions actually displayed or described can be assessed. Finite-field labels with complex amplitudes do not replace the complex Hilbert space. Q_p and adeles are infinite; no universal divergence-free conclusion follows.
entries.evidence: All missing-suite validation, physical unification, exact long-time numerical probability conservation and hardware performance assertions remain unverified.
